item.title: Housing activity weakens in latest Fed Beige Book report
item.description: Most Federal Reserve districts reporting on residential real estate cited softer home sales, slower construction and reduced lending.

item.title: Court advised to reject legal bid to compel NAR rule enforcement
item.description: A magistrate judge recommends denying Zea’s injunction against NAR and MLSs, citing delay and lack of harm evidence.

item.title: One year later, insurance hurdles and red tape slow Los Angeles wildfire recovery
item.description: Insurance, regulation and high costs are slowing wildfire recovery in Los Angeles, leaving most displaced residents still waiting.

item.title: HomeAdvantage, Affinity Federal Credit Union relaunch partnership
item.description: Through HomeAdvantage, members can access home search tools, local market insights and connections to experienced real estate professionals.

item.description: California’s emerging housing fracas over a single stairwell may become a lightning rod, affecting both building codes and capital investment in more multifamily projects in more places. item.title: US foreclosure filings rise 14% in 2025 as FHA borrowers face greater risk
item.description: U.S. foreclosure filings rose 14% in 2025 to 367,460 properties, but they remain 87% below the 2010 peak, according to ATTOM data.

item.title: REMAX adds two major Toronto brokerages from Royal LePage
item.description: REMAX gains 1,200 agents and 17 offices in Toronto as two Risi-led Royal LePage firms convert.

item.title: Ohio lawmakers push for senior foreclosure protection
item.description: Ohio ranked No. 6 among states for highest foreclosure rates in October 2025, with one in every 3,079 homes receiving a foreclosure filing.

item.title: Kim Harris Campbell named CEO of Century 21 New Millennium, Hetherington moves to board
item.description: Kim Harris Campbell, a former Compass executives, was named CEO of Century 21 New Millennium, succeeding firm co-founder Todd Hetherington.

item.title: Early Alexander Brothers accuser found dead in Australia
item.description: The woman filed a civil lawsuit in March 2024 accusing the Alexander brothers of sexually assaulting her more than a decade earlier.
